QuestInfo.name: Honnou-ji Infiltration 2
QuestInfo.0: You made it to the Honnou-ji entrance. Touch base with Kanetsugu and go over the infiltration plan.
QuestInfo.1: The princess is in here somewhere. Hurry to the eastern wing and rescue her!
QuestInfo.2: You successfully rescued the princess from Honnou-ji. Surprisingly, she seems fine.

0.0: Shingen was right. I snooped around the area while you were on your way and the security here is quite lacking.
0.1: We're so close to the eastern temple wing. I almost feel sorry for the enemy. But Master Kenshin's first rule is no mercy, so Oda's Army will see none from us! Kanna, I leave the rescue of the princess to you.

yes.0: I shall remain here to protect the escape route. Be cautious. It is still possible that the frail security is a trap.

default.0: I don't see Princess Sakuno by your side.
